title: Nimbus Labs releases Orion-3, a multimodal model with a 2 million token context window
excerpt: Nimbus Labs said Orion-3 can take text, images and audio together and handle up to 2 million tokens. The company claims it beats rivals on reasoning benchmarks and will be available to developers through an API from next week.

title: Open-source LLM Kestrel 70B matches closed models on coding tests
excerpt: Kestrel 70B, released under an open licence, uses a mixture-of-experts design that activates 12 billion parameters per token, its developers said.

title: Brightline adds on-device AI assistant to its new phones
excerpt: The assistant runs locally on a neural processing unit, so many requests never leave the phone, Brightline said.

title: Vela AI cuts inference costs by half with new quantisation method
excerpt: The 4-bit quantisation technique shrinks models with little loss in accuracy, Vela AI said in a technical report.

title: Atlas Robotics shows humanoid that learns tasks from video
excerpt: The robot watches short clips of people doing chores and copies them, using a vision-language-action model.

title: Chipmaker Halcyon to build $20 billion semiconductor plant in Arizona
excerpt: Halcyon said the plant will make 3-nanometre chips for AI data centres and create about 3,000 jobs when it opens in 2029.

title: AI start-up Corvid raises $400 million at $5 billion valuation
excerpt: Corvid, which builds AI agents for customer service, said the funding round was led by two venture firms and will be used to hire engineers.

title: EU agrees rules for general-purpose AI models
excerpt: Under the deal, makers of the largest models must publish summaries of training data and report serious incidents, officials said.

title: Retailer Maple says AI will replace 1,200 call-centre roles
excerpt: Maple said it would retrain some staff and that chatbots now handle most routine customer questions.

title: Cloud firm Stratos signs GPU deal worth $8 billion
excerpt: Stratos will rent graphics processing units to AI companies under a five-year agreement, it said.

title: Bengaluru start-up Sutra launches Hindi and Tamil voice AI for farmers
excerpt: Sutra's assistant answers questions about crops and weather by phone in 10 Indian languages, the company said.

title: Government adds 14,000 GPUs to national AI compute pool
excerpt: The new capacity under the IndiaAI Mission will be offered to start-ups and researchers at subsidised rates, the ministry said.

title: Global chip firm Halcyon to open design centre in Hyderabad
excerpt: Halcyon said the centre will employ 2,000 engineers working on AI chip design.

title: IIT Madras researchers build low-cost AI model for TB screening
excerpt: The model reads chest X-rays and flags likely tuberculosis cases for doctors to review, the institute said.

title: Mumbai bank rolls out AI fraud checks on UPI payments
excerpt: The bank said machine learning now scores each UPI transaction for fraud risk in under a second.

title: Researchers teach AI to predict protein shapes in seconds
excerpt: The team said its deep learning model predicts how proteins fold far faster than earlier methods, which could speed up drug discovery.

title: MIT engineers build chip that runs neural networks with light
excerpt: The photonic chip performs the maths of a neural network using light instead of electricity, cutting energy use, the researchers said.

title: New method spots AI-generated images with 98% accuracy
excerpt: Scientists say their detector finds tiny patterns left by image generators.

title: Study finds smaller models can learn to reason with better training data
excerpt: A research team trained a 3 billion parameter model on carefully chosen problems and found it rivalled much larger models on maths tests.

title: Robot hand learns to sort objects by touch alone
excerpt: Using reinforcement learning, the hand learned to tell objects apart without cameras, according to the lab.
